platform.name: Name
platform.storageIntro: NeuroCapture stores no videos. Each hospital connects its own storage before its phones can record; these are the kinds it can choose.
platform.kindS3: Amazon S3: the hospital's bucket and an upload role that trusts this platform
platform.kindAzure: Azure Blob: the hospital's container and a role for NeuroCapture's Azure app
platform.azureHowTo: To offer Azure: register one multi-tenant app in NeuroCapture's Microsoft Entra ID, put its ID and secret in the key vault as NC_AZURE_CLIENT_ID and NC_AZURE_CLIENT_SECRET, and restart the API. Steps: docs/deploy/azure.md, step 5b.
platform.devStorageOn: This is a test server: development storage is on (NC_DEV_STORAGE). Never use it with real patients.
platform.serverOutdated: This platform server is older than the dashboard and has no settings page yet. Update and restart the platform (the API), then reload this page.
platform.hospitalsSub: {{count}} hospitals on NeuroCapture · counts only, never patient names
platform.counts: {{devices}} clinic phones · {{operators}} operators · {{patients}} patients in the app

hospital.connectorKey: Connector public key (from python -m ncconnector keygen)
hospital.sampleMrn: One sample MRN for the records test
hospital.keysHint: Created on the connector with python -m ncconnector rotate-take-key. Phones encrypt each recording for the active key.
hospital.noKey: No key yet: phones cannot record until the connector registers one.
hospital.externalId: ExternalId for the role's trust policy
hospital.patientsTitle: Invite patients to record at home
hospital.search: Search your records: name or MRN
hospital.viaEmail: E-mail with QR code and link (free)
hospital.viaSms: SMS link and code (paid by your hospital)
hospital.viaPrint: Print QR to hand over at the visit
hospital.deletionHint: The patient withdrew consent and asked for deletion. Delete the recordings in your storage, then mark it done.
hospital.clinicalEvents: Clinical activity (kept in your hospital's database)
hospital.deskDoes: Patients, join invites, appointments and doctor assignments are handled by the front desk (receptionist accounts, added under Team).
hospital.teamHint: Add as many hospital admins, front-desk staff and doctors as you need. Everyone signs in with their own e-mail, password and authenticator code, and everyone with the same role sees the same pages. Do not share logins: the activity log records each person by name.
hospital.checkNote: A phone is added only after its camera check passes ({{min}} fps or more; below {{take}} is borderline: some takes may need repeating). A registration code is used only when a phone is added, so a failed check never needs a new code. "In use" counts every take recorded on the phone, retakes included.
hospital.result_not_delivered: Not sent: the e-mail or SMS could not be delivered. Try again, or print the QR code.
hospital.storageAzure: Your own Azure Blob container: {{account}} / {{container}} (write-only role)
hospital.azureStep1: A Global Administrator of your Microsoft Entra tenant approves the NeuroCapture app once:
hospital.azureStep2: In your subscription, create the custom role below (it can write blobs only: no read, list or delete).
hospital.azureStep3: On your storage account, assign the NeuroCapture app the role "Storage Blob Delegator"; on the container, assign it the custom role.
hospital.azureStep4: Give your hospital connector "Storage Blob Data Reader" on the container (its managed identity), then enter the details and test.
hospital.azureRole: Custom role (JSON for the Azure portal or az role definition create)
hospital.azureNotOffered: Azure Blob storage is not available on this platform yet: NeuroCapture's Azure app is not registered. Use your own Amazon S3 bucket, or ask NeuroCapture to turn Azure on.
hospital.storageNone: Not connected. Connect your own Amazon S3 bucket or Azure Blob container below.
hospital.storageDev: Development storage on this test server (not for real patients).
hospital.storageWhy: Recordings go straight from the phones into your own cloud storage, encrypted with your hospital's key. NeuroCapture keeps no copy and stores no videos: it only signs short upload links that can write one recording and nothing else.
hospital.recordingOff: Recording is off until your video storage passes its test. Phones show that your hospital is not ready to receive recordings.

doctor.fetchedNow: From your hospital records · fetched just now
doctor.unavailable: Your hospital system is not answering. The recordings below still open.
doctor.decrypted: Videos from your storage, decrypted by your connector
doctor.rerecordDone: The patient's app now shows a new recording as due.
doctor.biomarkerHint: Computed at your hospital from the 60 fps videos; results written to your database under the NCID. Decision support only, not a diagnosis.
doctor.noPatients: No patients are assigned to you yet. The reception desk assigns patients to doctors.
doctor.periodic: Also record at home every N days until the next appointment (only if you want it)
doctor.periodicUntil: Repeats stop at the next appointment, {{date}}.
doctor.periodicNoAppt: No appointment booked yet: repeats stop at the next one reception books.

perm.title: {{hospital}} · Roles and permissions
perm.hint: Tick what each role may do at this hospital. The defaults are NeuroCapture's standard set; change them only when the hospital asks (for example, a small clinic where the doctor books appointments). Changes apply at once (within 10 minutes on the hospital connector) and are logged with your name and reason.

messaging.title: Messages to patients: e-mail and SMS
messaging.intro: Invites and reminders go out from your hospital's own accounts. These settings go straight from this browser to your hospital connector and are kept there, encrypted. NeuroCapture never receives them; passwords and keys are never shown again.
messaging.dltHint: India: texts must match your DLT templates (invite and reminder; see config/messages). The test SMS uses the reminder template.

smsFields.country_code: Country code for numbers without one

moves.title: Change {{name}}’s appointment
moves.fhir: Booked in the hospital system. NeuroCapture cannot write to it (read-only): after you save here, also move it there. NeuroCapture keeps your change until the hospital system’s time changes again.
moves.wants: The patient would like: {{days}} · {{part}} · reason: {{reason}}. The appointment stays as booked until you answer.
moves.freeHint: Free times come from each doctor’s clinic hours (Team page) minus their booked appointments. Check the doctor’s other commitments too.
moves.doctorChange: Doctor changes to {{to}} (from {{from}}). {{to}} gets access to this appointment; the tests chosen so far stay and can be changed.
moves.notify: Tell the patient by SMS or e-mail too (from the hospital’s own accounts)
moves.saveIncomplete: Choose a date, a time and a reason
moves.declineHint: The patient sees your answer in the app. You can also pick any other date above: the patient’s choices are a guide, not a limit.
moves.declined: Answer sent to {{name}}. The appointment stays as booked.
moves.inboxHint_one: {{count}} patient asked to change their appointment. It stays as booked until you answer. Oldest first.
moves.inboxHint_other: {{count}} patients asked to change their appointment. Each stays as booked until you answer. Oldest first.

settings.title: Settings
settings.phonesHint: A phone records a short test before it is added (clinic phones and patients’ phones). Choose how many frames a second it must reach. You can be stricter than NeuroCapture’s minimum, not looser.
settings.fpsNote: Every recording still needs 59 frames a second; phones that pass below {{warn}} are shown as borderline. Phones already added are not checked again.
settings.patientChanges: Patients may ask to change an appointment in the app
settings.cutoff: Until how long before the appointment
settings.timeZoneHint: Clinic hours, free times and the days patients choose are in this time zone.
settings.patientBooking: Patients who joined may ask for an appointment in the app
settings.bookingHint: Which doctors are offered: Team → clinic hours → “Bookable in the app”. The desk confirms each booking.
settings.offersHint: The offered times are held for the patient until they answer. No answer by then: the appointment stays and the desk sees “No answer”.
settings.recordingsTitle: Home recordings when an appointment moves
settings.recordingsHint: A recording made within this many days of the new date counts for it; an older one asks for a new recording with the same tests.

booking_days_ahead.label: How far ahead they may book

recording_valid_days.label: A recording counts if made within

settings.phoneConsent: Patients without the app may agree on the clinic phone
settings.consentHint: Patients with the app agree in it and show a one-time QR code that the clinic phone scans before recording. If this is on, a patient without the app (or who cannot show the code) reads and agrees on the clinic phone, and the operator records why.

hours.title: Doctors’ clinic hours
hours.hint: Used only to suggest free times when the front desk moves an appointment. Enter each doctor’s weekly hours in the hospital’s time zone, for example 09:00-13:00, 14:00-17:00. Leave a day empty when they do not see patients.
hours.noDoctors: No doctors yet. Invite them above.
hours.badFormat: Write hours as 09:00-13:00, with commas between them.
hours.bookable: Bookable in the app (patients can ask for this doctor)

offers.modeHint: Offer choices: the patient picks one in the app; the times are held for them.
offers.notJoined: This patient does not use the app: move it now and phone them.
offers.bookTitle: Offer {{name}} times for a new appointment
offers.wantedHint_one: The patient's {{count}} time is highlighted in the calendar.
offers.wantedHint_other: The patient's {{count}} times are highlighted in the calendar.
offers.pickHint: Click free times to add them to the choices (up to {{max}}).
offers.heldTitle: Held for another patient until they answer
offers.heldFor: These times are held for {{name}} until they answer, or for {{hours}} hours. Nobody else can be booked into them.
offers.currentGone: No longer possible: {{name}} must choose one, or cancel
offers.currentKeep: Still possible: {{name}} may also keep it
offers.sent_one: {{count}} choice sent to {{name}}. You will see the answer in Requests.
offers.sent_other: {{count}} choices sent to {{name}}. You will see the answer in Requests.
offers.recRecorded: Home recording already made: it counts for the new date if that date is within {{days}} days of it; a later date sends a new link with the same tests (or the new doctor chooses).
offers.recNotYet: Not recorded yet: the record-by date moves with the appointment. With another doctor, that doctor confirms the tests first.

requests.checkedNow: Each time is checked against clinic hours and bookings now. Book a free one, offer other times, or decline.
requests.withdrawn: Offer withdrawn. Change the appointment from the list, or offer new times.
requests.countHint: The menu count is what needs the desk: new bookings, change requests, offers with no answer and patients asking to be called.

cancel.title: Cancel {{name}}'s appointment?
cancel.notify: Tell {{name}} (app, plus SMS/e-mail from the hospital's accounts)
cancel.what: Open record links are cancelled; recordings already made stay with the hospital. Can be done at any time.

noShow.title: Did {{name}} not come?
noShow.notify: Tell {{name}} (app, plus SMS/e-mail from the hospital's accounts)
noShow.what: The appointment is cancelled and open record links are closed. {{doctor}} is told by e-mail. Recordings already made stay with the hospital.
noShow.whatNoDoctor: The appointment is cancelled and open record links are closed. Recordings already made stay with the hospital.
noShow.done: {{name}}'s appointment on {{when}} is marked as did not come and cancelled.
